column7: 2026-11-06: User rule for this vendored branch (vendor/deploy-tools): nothing here may emit any warning (deploy-tools CI runs tests with -W error; a vendored DeprecationWarning broke their release in March). If something is renamed or retired, the old spelling must keep working silently, no DeprecationWarning.

2026-11-06: Finding (not fixed, out of scope of the v-prefix task): semver.* deprecated shims (semver.main, cmd_*, bump_*, etc. in _deprecated.py) emit DeprecationWarning by design, and ~157 existing tests fail under -W error on baseline. Conflicts with the no-warnings rule; ask user before changing. New CLI tests use semver.cli.main to stay warning-free.

2026-11-06: My choices (not user rules): Version.compare dict deprecation uses warnings.warn (stacklevel=2), not the deprecated helper, because the helper warns on every call and only dict args are deprecated. Comparison operators (==, <) with a dict deliberately do not warn; the user scoped this to compare() only. Unconfirmed guesses: changelog fragment named pr506.deprecation.rst (PR number guessed) and docstring says 'deprecated:: 3.0.0'. Uncommitted v-prefix CLI work (pr505) shares this working tree; keep it out of this PR's commit.

2026-11-06: next_version keyword renamed prerelease_token -> token (keyword-only prerelease_token alias kept). Alias is documented as deprecated (docstring + changelog) but emits NO warning, per the branch no-warnings rule. Don't add DeprecationWarning.
